title: The in-memory outcome records kept the written object itself, so a later change to it altered the stored record, unlike PostgreSQL
resolution: The adapter stores a frozen copy; a shared conformance case that changes the input after the write failed on the in-memory adapter before the fix and passes after it.

title: No test covered a placement that commits while the waiting record's transaction is open after its waiting read, the case the serializable guard exists for
resolution: Added a PostgreSQL test, with and without an earlier record, that places the task on another connection while the waiting record's transaction pauses after its read, and expects a serialization retry and no record left. It needs Docker.

title: The removal of the outcome on placement was tested only when it succeeds; a failed removal was not shown to roll the placement back
resolution: Added a unit test and a PostgreSQL test that fail the removal: the pass fails, the earlier record stays, and in PostgreSQL no assignment, offer, or cursor move commits. The unit test failed with the removal error ignored.

title: The contract still said a pass whose first offer meets a full fleet writes nothing, although it now writes a waiting record
resolution: The statement now covers only the cursor and points to the recorded outcome bullet.

title: The record said the PostgreSQL tests first ran at the passing make verify, although the failed run on the merge had already run them
resolution: The record names both runs: the tests passed in the failed run on the merge and again in the passing run.
